editorial:
Ever feel like some people just deserve what they get? You will love that feeling here, as you get two creepy stories based on Edgar Allan Poe. First, you meet a greedy wife who is just waiting for her sick husband to kick the bucket so she can steal his money. Then, you shift to a sleazy reporter who takes in a weird black cat that seems to have a mind of its own. It feels like a dark bedtime story told by a friend who loves a good scare, and it keeps you on your toes with a gloomy, spooky atmosphere that makes you want to turn the lights on.

The acting is great, and the way the stories move along is quick and punchy. You might find some of the effects a bit dated since it is from 1990, but that actually adds to the charm. If you love twisty plots and a bit of irony, you need to see this. Since it looks so moody, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move so you can rewatch these twisted tales whenever you want.
endingExplained: In the first story, the greedy wife's plan backfires when her husband reveals he knew everything. He tricks her into a trap where she ends up suffering the same fate she wanted for him. In the second story, the reporter's life falls apart because of the black cat. He tries to hide his crimes, but the cat leads the police right to the evidence. Both characters get a taste of their own medicine in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school horror and gothic stories.
